name: markstream-vue
title_zh: 把 Markdown 流式渲染嵌进 Vue 3 的接
tagline_zh: AI 长回答逐字蹦，你的页面还在等整段？这套 skill 帮你接好虚拟滚动与时间轴，让长流不卡、不闪、不丢帧。
tagline_en: AI tokens stream in, but your Vue page waits for the whole blob? This skill wires virtual scrolling & a timeline.
desc_en: Integrate markstream-vue into a Vue 3 app. Use when Codex needs to add the Vue 3 renderer, import CSS in the right order, choose renderer and DOM modes, choose built-in, plain, or custom code-block paths, choose between `content` and `nodes`, coordinate long AI timelines with `MarkstreamVirtualTimeline`, `useMarkstreamVirtualAdapter`, or `vue-virtual-scroller`, enable optional peers such as stream
why_zh: 它不只会贴代码，而是把渲染器、DOM 模式、CSS 引入顺序、content/nodes 取舍全串成一。
why_en: Not just code snippets—it chains renderer, DOM mode, CSS order, and content/nodes choices into one decision path, with.
limit_zh: 只覆盖 Vue 3 + markstream-vue 的接入层；不处理 markdown 语法扩展、不修样式细节。
limit_en: Vue 3 + markstream-vue integration only. No markdown syntax extensions, no style tweaks, no perf tuning. Useless for Vue 2 or non-Vite builds.
title_en: Wire markstream-vue into your Vue 3 app
